artist.name: Rihanna
artist.profile:
Barbadian recording artist, actress and fashion designer, born February 20, 1988 in Saint Michael, Barbados.
She began her career as a result of meeting record producer [a=Evan Rogers] in late 2003.
At age 16, she moved to the United States to pursue a recording career and began recording demo tapes under Rogers' guidance, subsequently signing a contract with Def Jam Recordings after auditioning for Jay-Z.

Rihanna has a Lyric contralto vocal type. Vocal Range: 3 octaves 2 notes (B2-D6)'.
